name: email.outreach
description: Gate every outbound email before it is queued. Outbound is irreversible.

specific_to_recipient.instructions: The email demonstrates specific knowledge of this recipient's situation rather than a mail-merge token

one_ask.instructions: There is exactly one clear ask

unverified_claim.instructions: States a metric, result, or outcome that is NEITHER reported first-hand from the author's own work or measurement, NOR attributed to a named source. A first-person report of what the author personally measured or observed is sourced and is NOT a violation; an unattributed claim about the industry, a third party, or 'studies' is.

generic_ai_slop.instructions: The email reads like generic AI-generated sales copy

banned_words.instructions: The copy uses any of: unlock, empower, synergy, leverage, disrupt, hustle, utilize, iterate, optimize

strength.instructions: How likely is this to earn a reply from a busy operator
criteria: Specific and useful enough that a reply is likely

rules.reason: unsourced claim in outbound -- ProofPacket law
weak, unlikely to earn a reply

notes.unverified_claim: reworded 2026-09-18 after a false block on a first-person audit post (decision id 6)
